hero.title: The biotech your lab needs, delivered across India
hero.subtitle: BioAzure distributes diagnostic and biotechnology products from six European principals to laboratories, hospitals, food companies, and IVD manufacturers across India, with cold-chain logistics and technical support from people who know the science.

whyBioazure.headline: Scientific depth. Reliable supply.
whyBioazure.body: BioAzure was started in 2009 by two PhDs who spent their careers in biotech before switching to distribution. That background shows up in how we work: we understand what you're testing, why the cold chain matters, and which product fits your workflow. We ship temperature-controlled across India and carry regulatory documentation for everything we distribute.

aboutStory: BioAzure started in Mumbai in 2009. Dr. Adrian Almeida and Dr. Asha Kulkarni Almeida, both with PhDs in biotechnology and years of industry experience, saw a gap: Indian labs needed better access to proven European diagnostic products, and the existing import channels were slow, expensive, or technically uninformed.

Moving boxes was never the point. They wanted to pair each product with the application knowledge that makes it useful, help customers through regulatory requirements, and keep pricing realistic for the Indian market. Technical support first, logistics second.

Over 17 years, BioAzure signed six principals across Europe: Liofilchem and Sacace in Italy, ViennaLab in Austria, Micreos in the Netherlands, Medix Biochemica in Finland, and Candor Bioscience in Germany. Each fills a specific niche, from culture media to phage-based food safety to IVD raw materials.

Seventeen years later, the customer base spans referral labs, hospitals, government institutions, food companies, IVD manufacturers, and research teams. Everything ships cold-chain when it needs to. And when you call with a technical question, you talk to someone who's worked with the product, not just sold it.

partners.liofilchem: Italian manufacturer of ready-to-use culture media and antimicrobial susceptibility testing products. Their plates, tubes, and MIC strips are used in clinical microbiology labs for pathogen isolation and resistance profiling, with product lines aligned to both EUCAST and CLSI standards.
partners.sacace: Italian developer of real-time and conventional PCR kits covering hepatitis, HIV, HPV, respiratory infections, and STIs. Sacace kits are a practical choice for Indian referral labs building out molecular diagnostics without committing to a single-platform ecosystem.
partners.viennalab: Austrian specialist in StripAssay reverse-hybridization kits for pharmacogenetics, thrombophilia screening, and HLA typing. The strip-based format lets labs offer targeted genotyping panels without the capital investment of next-gen sequencing.
partners.micreos: Dutch company behind PhageGuard, a bacteriophage-based approach to food safety. PhageGuard Listex targets Listeria and PhageGuard S targets Salmonella on food contact surfaces, without chemicals or antibiotics. Increasingly relevant for Indian food exporters meeting international standards.
partners.medix: Finnish supplier of antibodies, antigens, and enzymes used by IVD manufacturers to build diagnostic assays. Medix raw materials go into cardiac marker, infectious disease, and hormone assays produced by kit makers worldwide, including several in India.
partners.candor: German immunoassay optimization specialist, part of the Medix Biochemica group. Their LowCross-Buffer and Assay Defender reagents solve real development headaches: heterophilic antibody interference, high background signal, and poor reagent shelf life in ELISA and lateral flow formats.

products.Culture Media: Ready-to-use plates, tubes, and dehydrated media from Liofilchem for microbial isolation and identification. The range includes chromogenic and selective media that help labs differentiate target organisms directly on the plate, reducing follow-up testing.
products.Antimicrobial Susceptibility Testing: Liofilchem's antibiotic discs and MIC test strips for resistance profiling by disc diffusion or minimum inhibitory concentration. Products cover a wide range of organism-antimicrobial combinations and work with current EUCAST and CLSI interpretive criteria.
products.PCR Diagnostic Kits: Sacace's real-time PCR kits for hepatitis B/C, HIV, HPV genotyping, respiratory panels, and STI detection. Both qualitative and quantitative formats available, compatible with common real-time PCR platforms.
products.StripAssay Kits: ViennaLab's reverse-hybridization strip tests for pharmacogenetics (CYP2D6, CYP2C19), thrombophilia (Factor V Leiden, Prothrombin), and HLA-B27. A cost-effective way to run targeted genotyping without sequencing infrastructure.
products.PhageGuard Solutions: Bacteriophage-based biocontrol from Micreos. PhageGuard Listex and PhageGuard S use naturally occurring phages to reduce Listeria and Salmonella on food surfaces. No chemicals, no antibiotics, no impact on taste or texture.
products.Immunodiagnostic Raw Materials: Antibodies, antigens, and enzymes from Medix Biochemica for IVD assay development and manufacturing. Used by kit makers building cardiac, infectious disease, and hormone assays who need consistent lot-to-lot performance at production scale.
products.Immunoassay Optimization: Candor Bioscience's LowCross-Buffer, Assay Defender, and HAMA blockers for ELISA and lateral flow development. If you're fighting background noise, heterophilic interference, or reagent degradation, these are purpose-built solutions from a team that specializes in assay troubleshooting.

applications.clinical-microbiology: Culture media and AST products from Liofilchem for pathogen isolation, identification, and resistance testing. We supply referral labs, hospital microbiology departments, and public health laboratories across India with cold-chain delivery.
applications.molecular-diagnostics: PCR kits from Sacace and StripAssay genotyping from ViennaLab for infectious disease testing, pharmacogenetics, and hereditary screening. Available to diagnostic labs and research institutions across India.
applications.food-safety: PhageGuard bacteriophage solutions from Micreos for targeted Listeria and Salmonella control in food processing. Relevant for Indian food manufacturers, exporters, and testing laboratories working to international food safety standards.
applications.ivd-raw-materials: Antibodies, antigens, enzymes, and assay optimization reagents from Medix Biochemica and Candor Bioscience. For Indian IVD manufacturers and R&D teams building or improving diagnostic assays.
